asr.full_text: Hello. This is a tutorial on how to buy BNB on phantom wallet in 2026. Phantom is a popular Multi chain Crypto wallet that supports Solana, Ethereum and also the BNB chain. Here is how to buy BNC directly through the phantom wallet app. 1st Download phantom walln from the app store or Google Play Store or install the browser extension on your desktop. Open the app and create a new wallet. Save your recovery phrase in a safe place as you will need it to restore your wallet if you ever lose access. Once your wallet is set-up, make sure that you are on the BNB Chain network. You can switch networks by tapping the network selector at the top on the app and choosing BNB chain from the list. Tap the Buy button on the home screen. Phantom will redirect you to an integrated third-party provider such as Moonpay or another supported onRamp. Select BNB as the cryptocurrency you want to purchase. Enter the dollar amount you want to spend. Follow the prompts to enter your payment details using a debit card or credit card. Complete identity verification if prompted by the payment provider. Once the purchase is confirmed, BNB will be sent directly to your Fantom wallet address on the BNB chain. You will see your updated balance on the home screen. Thanks for watching.
